headline: Site plan review for a 179-apartment building with retail space at 37 Enon Street, plus sign applications.
summary: The meeting covers a site plan review for 37 Enon Street, where the existing Stop and Shop would be demolished and replaced with 179 apartments and +/- 2,600 square feet of retail space. It also includes sign applications for three businesses and a discussion of temporary signs and banners.
items: Wall sign and window signs for Gold Coast Pilates Therapy at 3 Dodge Street, applicant Seaside Graphics, Inc.
Window signs for The Happy Crab Play Center at 451 Essex Street, applicant Seaside Graphics, Inc.
Freestanding sign for PerioNorth at 56 Dodge Street, applicant Bruna Mengazzi

Site plan review for 37 Enon Street: demolition of existing Stop and Shop and construction of a new building with 179 one and two bedroom apartments and +/- 2,600 square foot retail space, applicant Beverly Tre LLC c/o Alexander and Femino
Discussion on temporary signage and temporary banners
location: Temporary City of Beverly City Hall, First Floor – Large Conference Room, 175 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA 01915
